quote:
Distribution Agreement § 18.1–18.2: Delaware law; exclusive jurisdiction in Wilmington, Delaware.
- Side Letter § 6.1–6.2: New York law; exclusive jurisdiction in New York County, New York. ... The parties could end up litigating related claims in two different forums under two different bodies of law. ... consider asking Velloran to conform the Side Letter's governing law and forum to Delaware as part of a restated side letter.
reason: Issue 5 of the memo covers all three parts of the criterion. It names the conflict between Side Letter §6 (New York law, exclusive New York County courts) and Distribution Agreement §§18.1–18.2 (Delaware law, exclusive Wilmington forum). It explains that claims about the same relationship could be split across two forums under two bodies of law: a non-compete breach is also a material breach of the Distribution Agreement under SL §4.3. It also recommends conforming the Side Letter's governing law and forum to Delaware. The recommendation is softened to 'consider asking' because Velloran must agree, but it still calls for conforming to Delaware.
